title: Collections
description: Collections are a series of achievements that reward you for having specific combinations of animals and items placed in your zoo at the same time. Each collection requires you to have a specific set of animals (and sometimes decorations or buildings) placed in your zoo simultaneously. The required animals must meet minimum level requirements and, in some cases, have a specific coat color. All required items must be present in your zoo at the same time — it is not enough to have owned them in the past. When viewing a collection, each required animal or item shows its minimum level and any coat color requirements. If a specific coat color is specified, you must have that exact color placed in your zoo.

messages.requiredName: At least one name is required
